101.name: Missing authorization
101.description: The catalog says the service needs prior authorization and the line has none. Denies the line amount.

102.name: Tariff difference
102.description: For services without an agreed price, the unit price exceeds the manual tariff by more than the tolerance. Denies the difference.

201.name: Invalid CUPS code
201.description: The code does not exist in the catalog. Denies the line amount.

202.name: Incomplete or expired authorization
202.description: The authorization lacks a number, date or validity, or the service was provided after it expired. Denies the line amount.

301.name: Clinical inconsistency
301.description: The service does not fit the patient (for example, an obstetric ultrasound billed for a male patient). Flagged for auditor review, with no amount.

303.name: Duplicate services
303.description: The same service is billed more than once for the same patient and date. Denies the repeated line.

401.name: Price above the contract
401.description: For services with an agreed price in the contract, the unit price exceeds it. Denies the difference, with no tolerance.

402.name: Quantity above authorized
402.description: The billed quantity exceeds the authorized one. Denies the extra units.

how.title: How the engine decides
how.subtitle: AI helps to read and to find; denials come from explicit rules your team can review.

steps.s1Text: In your project, AI extracts the provider, patient, diagnoses and every service with its code, quantity and price from the invoice and its supporting documents. In this demo the sample batch is already structured.
steps.s2Text: Each code is looked up in the CUPS catalog and the reference tariff is computed from the manual or the agreed price in the contract.
steps.s3Text: Each rule is a condition you can read and test: authorization, tariff, quantities, duplicates and basic consistency. AI never decides a denial.
steps.s4Text: Each proposed denial shows the rule, the compared values and the denied amount, as you can see in the simulator.
steps.s5Text: In your project, the auditor accepts, adjusts or discards each denial before sending it to the provider.

how.aiTitle: What AI does and does not do
how.ai1: Does: extract data from documents (in your project) and search codes by meaning with embeddings (on the server, when the catalog has vectorized codes).
how.ai2: Does not: decide denials. Rules are explicit, auditable conditions.
how.ai3: Does not: file or send denials without human review.
